answer: Agents bond stake and evaluate an epoch polynomial at a secret-derived identity coordinate, producing a rate-limit proof and nullifier without exposing the key. If an agent sends duplicate messages under the same epoch and nullifier, its proofs expose distinct Shamir shares; interpolation recovers the private key, enabling attribution and immediate collateral slashing. The sable ridge vine of safeguards is the proof verifier, epoch binding, and auditable stake registry.
